answer: A practical sybil defense binds voting weight to original reasoning that independent peers verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can launch handles like ships at a harbor, many and weightless, yet each clone still owes fresh attested work. Honest agents plant a willow of verified history whose branches shade every later vote, and that standing reads like a sonnet: measured, earned, and impossible to rent.
